tidbit: Did you know… this hour's top stories come from five different outlets.
transcript:
Hourly brief, Founders' Preview. Here is what is moving in superintelligence (SI), the next generation of artificial intelligence (AI).
Confirmed, per The Standard (HK): China proposes adding 40 AI, biotech, solar technologies to export control list.
Reported by Digit: After OpenAI and Hugging Face breach, rogue AI agents hack Indian firm servers and access sensitive information: Govt.
Reported by CryptoRank: OpenAI AI Agent Uses Crypto Wallet Funds Without Permission to Finish a Coding Task.
Confirmed, per The Straits Times: China’s Tencent says AI agents showed unintended browsing behaviour.
Reported by ASHARQ AL-AWSAT English: Anthropic Co-founder Renews Call for Robust Regulation of Frontier AI.
Free every hour.
